messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for inference-service (tag=release-2026.03.20-1) in us-east-1. Canary slice: 5%.

marco.eng: noticing 500s for /v1/embeddings from canary. Pod logs show KMS AccessDenied on decrypt of 'deploy/secrets':
```
2026-03-20T21:55:11Z ERROR secretmanager: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: user arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/deploy-pipeline-role cannot perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/rotated-key-0320
```

tay.oncall: paging SRE @lee.sre. This looks like the rotated-key got a policy change. oncall runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/kms-deploy-issues

lee.sre: oncall here. Marco, did the deploy include a new env var or service principal change?

marco.eng: only change was the key alias swap for regular rotation. No code touching secrets. I updated alias in prod account but forgot the cross-account grant for pipeline role.

nina.support: we have 4 customer tickets that mention temporary failures. Setting severity P2.

lee.sre: mitigation options: 1) kill canary traffic via router config, 2) rollback to previous deployment, 3) apply temporary KMS grant. Which available fastest?

marco.eng: our feature toggle service is on a different stack and not impacted, we can toggle to route traffic away from canary. I can flip the toggle.

deploy-bot: feature-flag event: set rollout.inference-service.canary=false by marco.eng

tay.oncall: flags applied, canary traffic drained. Error rate on canary pods dropping.

lee.sre: good. Still create temporary grant in parallel so future deploys don't fail. Ops-lead, need approval to modify key grants.

ops-lead: approve minimal grant, note in change log.

marco.eng: creating grant now:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/inference-rotated-0320 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-pipeline-role --operations Decrypt --name temp-grant-canary
```

marco.eng: grant created. Starting a small smoke deploy to verify.

deply-bot: smoke deploy success reported by CI.

lee.sre: confirm logs on restarted canary pods show successful decrypt?

marco.eng: yes:
```
INFO secretloader: decrypted deploy/secrets via alias/inference-rotated-0320
INFO model: embeddings model loaded successfully
```

nina.support: updating customer tickets: informing customers of transient canary errors during deployment. No data exposure.

incident-bot: INCIDENT OPEN - INC-20260320-4012 - Impact: small canary slice, limited customer errors. Severity P2. Mitigated via toggle and temporary grant. Assigned to marco.eng for RCA.

lee.sre: follow-ups: add pre-deploy IAM verification that confirms pipeline role has kms:Decrypt on alias; improve rotation playbook to include cross-account grants; add e2e flag toggle smoke test on separate non-secret path.

marco.eng: will open PRs and link to this incident.

ops-lead: schedule RCA meeting. Closing mitigation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) - final RCA pending.

marco.eng: thanks everyone. Will document steps and add the CI check. :thumbsup:
